steps.content:
PLAN
1. List the directory and read the files named in the task.
2. Create a new file named `fuzz_ini.c` in the root of the repository.
3. Include the `src/ini.h` header file in `fuzz_ini.c`.
4. Define the `int LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(const uint8_t *data, size_t size)` function.
5. Inside the function, declare a `char out[64];` array and call `ini_get((const char*)data, size, "a.b", out, sizeof out)`.
6. Also call `ini_count((const char*)data, size)`.
7. Return 0 from the function.
8. Build the harness using the command: `clang -g -O1 -fsanitize=fuzzer,address,undefined fuzz_ini.c src/ini.c -I . -o harness`.
9. Run the build to ensure it compiles and runs without errors.
